python -c "
import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_excel('budget.xlsx', header=None, skiprows=8, usecols=[0,2])
df.columns = ['Category', 'Amount']
df = df[df['Amount'].notna()]
print('Per-category totals:')
print(df.groupby('Category')['Amount'].sum().to_string())
print()
print('Total expenses:', df['Amount'].sum())
print()
print('Number of expense items:', len(df))
"
